Load data
```{r}
Blood_5p_CD4 <- readRDS("~/PRIMUS/data/48_lab/Project Crohn/Project Crohn Predict/Data/Datasets/Blood_CD4_5p.rds")
Gut_5p_CD4 <- readRDS("~/PRIMUS/data/48_lab/Project Crohn/Project Crohn Predict/Data/Datasets/Gut_CD4_5p.rds")
```


```{r}
head(Blood_5p_CD4@meta.data) 
```

```{r}
cols_to_keep <- c("orig.ident", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "participant_id", "diagnosis", "timepoint", "age", "sex", "tissue", "layer", "antitnf_response") 
Blood_5p_CD4@meta.data <- Blood_5p_CD4@meta.data[, cols_to_keep]

head(Blood_5p_CD4@meta.data)
```



```{r}
head(Gut_5p_CD4@meta.data)
```


```{r}
cols_to_keep <- c("orig.ident", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "participant_id", "diagnosis", "timepoint",  "age", "sex", "tissue", "layer", "antitnf_response") 
Gut_5p_CD4@meta.data <- Gut_5p_CD4@meta.data[, cols_to_keep]

head(Gut_5p_CD4@meta.data)
```


Add unique cell names
```{r}
Blood_5p_CD4 <- RenameCells(Blood_5p_CD4, add.cell.id = "Blood")
Gut_5p_CD4   <- RenameCells(Gut_5p_CD4, add.cell.id = "Gut")
```



```{r}
DefaultAssay(Blood_5p_CD4) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Gut_5p_CD4) <- "RNA"

# Combine the two datasets
Blood_Gut <- merge(
  Blood_5p_CD4,
  y = Gut_5p_CD4
)
```


# Integration based on participant_id and tissue
```{r}
Blood_Gut$integration_group <- paste(
  Blood_Gut$tissue_general,
  Blood_Gut$participant_id,
  sep = "_"
)

table(Blood_Gut$integration_group)
```


```{r}
datasets <- SplitObject(
  Blood_Gut,
  split.by = "integration_group"
)

length(datasets)
names(datasets)
```


```{r}
datasets <- lapply(
  datasets,
  NormalizeData
)

datasets <- lapply(
  datasets,
  FindVariableFeatures,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 1000
)
```


```{r}
# STACAS integration
Blood_Gut_stacas <- Run.STACAS(
  datasets,
  anchor.features = 1000
)

saveRDS(Blood_Gut_stacas, "~/PRIMUS/data/48_lab/Project Crohn/Project Crohn Predict/Data/Datasets/Integrated_Blood_Gut_CD4_5p_new.rds")
```


```{r}
Blood_Gut_stacas_5p <- readRDS("~/PRIMUS/data/48_lab/Project Crohn/Project Crohn Predict/Data/Datasets/Integrated_Blood_Gut_CD4_5p_new.rds")
```


```{r}
Blood_Gut_stacas_5p <- RunPCA(
  Blood_Gut_stacas_5p,
  npcs = 30
)
```


```{r}
Blood_Gut_stacas_5p <- FindNeighbors(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, dims = 1:20)
Blood_Gut_stacas_5p <- FindClusters(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, resolution = 0.5)
Blood_Gut_stacas_5p <- RunUMAP(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, dims = 1:20)


DimPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, group.by = "tissue")
DimPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, group.by = "participant_id")
DimPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, label = T)
```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
DimPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, group.by = "participant_id")
```



```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=18}
DimPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, split.by = "tissue")
```

DefaultAssay(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p) <- "RNA"

```{r}
FeaturePlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, features = "IFIT1", min.cutoff = 0)
```



```{r}
Idents(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p) <- Blood_Gut_stacas_5p$seurat_clusters

markers <- FindAllMarkers(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
```


```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=16}
DotPlot(Blood_Gut_stacas_5p, group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
        features = c("CTSW", "TRDC", "TRGC1", "SCART1", "IL9R", "GZMK", "EOMES", "TIGIT", "IL10RA", "KLRK1", "JCHAIN", "FOXP3", "IKZF2", "CTLA4", "IL2RA", "CD27",  "FCRL3", "GZMA", "GZMB", "PRF1", "CCL5", "CXCR3", "CXCR6", "IL26", "IFNG", "ITGB1", "AHNAK", "PLP2", "ANXA2", "TIMP1", "GATA3", "CCR10", "NPDC1", "CXCR5", "TOX2", "PDCD1", "ICOS", "BCL6", "IL21", "CXCR4", "BATF", "TNFRSF1B", "TBC1D4", "TNFRSF18", "TNFRSF4", "PASK", "KLF2", "S1PR1", "ITGA4", "IL2", "CD69", "RORA", "RORC", "KLRB1", "IL17A", "IL23R", "ITGA1", "CCR6", "CCR7", "TCF7", "LEF1", "SELL"), assay = "RNA") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colors = c('dodgerblue', 'gray90', 'indianred2')) +

```
